rationale: The parties have partially aligned on the need for a negotiated, non-cosmetic restructuring, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state reject closures and compulsory redundancies as starting points, while management, owners, and investors still insist on material capacity reduction and cannot commit to the no-closure/no-forced-layoff line. Positions are firm but not yet fully hardened into a stable impasse, so another round could still test whether an equivalent alternative package is feasible.
